criteria.requirement: Add _Paragraph.bullet read and set_bullet(kind,character="•",scheme="arabicPeriod",start=1). kind character/number/none or None inheritance; single character, number scheme from pinned ST_TextAutonumberScheme and strict 1..32767 start. Validate before mutation; replace mutually exclusive buNone/buChar/buAutoNum/buBlip only, insert before tabLst/defRPr/extLst per XSD. Preserve text, level, font and other paragraph properties, read unsupported image bullet as unsupported without implicit mutation. Real saved/reopened OOXML, never prefix fake numbering text.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
